name: CarSide curated list
readme: Hand-maintained automotive events. Each entry needs either start/end (ISO 8601 with offset) or a recurrence rule. Coordinates come from OpenStreetMap/Nominatim. See README.md → 'Adding curated events'.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Morrisville
events.description: Large themed monthly meet on the first Saturday of every month, year-round, in the Imperial Center business park off Page Road. All makes and models of cars, trucks and motorcycles are welcome; each month has a theme and a featured charity.
events.notes: Organizer confirms first Saturday, 8–11 AM, at Page Road. Themed dates for 2026 are listed separately.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Morrisville
events.subtitle: Motorcycle Day · Childhood Cancer Awareness
events.description: September edition of the first-Saturday Cars and Coffee Morrisville meet. This month's theme is Motorcycle Day, with Childhood Cancer Awareness as the featured charity.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Morrisville
events.subtitle: Classic Car Day (1979 and older) · Breast Cancer Awareness
events.description: October edition of Cars and Coffee Morrisville. Theme is Classic Car Day for 1979-and-older vehicles, with Breast Cancer Awareness as the featured charity.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Morrisville
events.subtitle: People's Choice Day · Right-hand-drive vehicles
events.description: November edition of Cars and Coffee Morrisville: People's Choice Day, featuring right-hand-drive vehicles.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Morrisville
events.subtitle: Tuner Car Day · Everything modified
events.description: December edition of Cars and Coffee Morrisville: Tuner Car Day for modified vehicles. The last date currently posted by the organizer.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Raleigh
events.description: Monthly meet on the fourth Sunday since 2017 — classics, exotics, hot rods, vendors and food trucks. The venue rotates around the Triangle; the organizer posts each month's location on Facebook and Instagram.
events.notes: Organizer confirms fourth Sunday, 8–11 AM. Glenwood Place is the venue listed for Sep 27 and Oct 25, 2026 — confirm on the organizer's social channels before attending.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Raleigh
events.subtitle: Glenwood Place · confirm venue on social
events.description: September fourth-Sunday edition of Cars and Coffee Raleigh, listed at Glenwood Place. Family-friendly meet with classics, exotics, everyday drivers and hot rods.
events.notes: Venue can rotate — confirm on the organizer's Facebook or Instagram.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Raleigh
events.subtitle: Glenwood Place · confirm venue on social
events.description: October fourth-Sunday edition of Cars and Coffee Raleigh, listed at Glenwood Place.
events.notes: Venue can rotate — confirm on the organizer's Facebook or Instagram.

events.title: Porsche Cary Cars & Coffee
events.description: Second-Saturday Cars & Coffee hosted by Porsche Cary with coffee, tech talks and demonstrations alongside enthusiast-owned classics and new Porsches. All marques welcome.
events.notes: Pattern verified via the Raleigh Car Shows listing (next dates Sep 12 and Oct 10, 2026); the dealer page could not be reached at verification time.

events.title: Caffeine & Machines
events.venue: Triangle Town Center (lot outside The Commons, near Macy's)
events.description: Free last-Saturday outdoor meet at Triangle Town Center with 200-plus cars of every style — modern exotics, muscle, classics, tuners — plus food trucks. All makes and models welcome.
events.notes: Next confirmed dates Sep 26 and Oct 31, 2026.

events.title: CECC Exotic Car Show
events.description: Monthly exotic and collector car show at the Carolina Exotic Car Club. Proceeds support the Ride of Your Life Foundation, which gives children and adults with disabilities rides in exotic cars.
events.notes: Listed as monthly; the last-Saturday pattern is inferred from the Sep 26 and Oct 31, 2026 dates.

events.title: Cars & Coffee at Park West Village
events.description: Informal weekly Sunday-morning gathering in the Park West Village parking area — described by a regional directory as the only weekly Cars & Coffee in the Triangle.
events.notes: Third-party listing only — no organizer page found. Check Park West Village's calendar or Facebook before relying on it.

events.title: Wake Forest Charity Car Show
events.admission: Spectators free · show-car fee not posted
events.description: Charity show welcoming muscle cars, street rods, classics, imports, exotics and trucks, with trophies by decade and Best in Show, a 50/50 drawing, concessions, DJ and raffles. Proceeds benefit Wake Forest Community Partners.

events.title: SunSet on the Farm Car & Truck Show
events.address: 1352 Old Drug Store Rd, Garner, NC 27529
events.admission: Spectators $5 · 12 and under free · $25 vehicle registration
events.description: Inaugural farm-site car and truck show: registration 8 AM – 1 PM, awards around 4 PM, Top 30 plus Best Of awards, 50/50, raffles and food trucks, with 150-plus vehicles expected.
events.notes: Organizer listed as SunSet Eastern NC; no official page found. Map pin is approximate (Old Drug Store Road).

events.title: AACA Antique Car Show
events.description: Antique car show on the grounds of the N.C. Transportation Museum, sponsored by the Furnitureland Chapter of the AACA and limited to AACA members' vehicles of all makes and models.

events.title: All Jeep Show
events.description: Jeep-only show at the N.C. Transportation Museum, from classic Willys to trail-ready Wranglers and custom builds.

events.title: SMART Modified Tour — Rumble in Rougemont
events.description: Touring modified night at the 3/8-mile Orange County Speedway with the SMART Modified Tour plus Carolina Crate Mods, VA Mini Cup and the OCS Charger, Pure Stock and MOD4 divisions. Grandstands open 5:30 PM, qualifying 6:00 PM, green flag 7:00 PM.
events.notes: End time is an estimate. Track notes the schedule is subject to change.

events.title: Orange County Speedway — Double Points Night
events.description: Saturday-night double points race for the Late Model, Charger, Pure Stock, MOD4 and Vintage divisions.
events.notes: Gate and green-flag times not posted yet. Admission shown is standard general admission.

events.title: Orange County Speedway — Race Night
events.subtitle: Make-up date for the July 18 rainout
events.description: Make-up race night running Late Model, Charger, Pure Stock, MOD4 and Vintage divisions plus the Crown Vic Outlaw Super Series and Legends.
events.notes: Times not posted yet. Admission shown is standard general admission.

events.title: Orange Blossom Shoot Out
events.subtitle: 5th annual · $10,000-to-win Late Model Stock 125
events.description: Orange County Speedway's season-ending Late Model Stock Car special — 125 laps, $10,000 to win under NASCAR LMSC rules — with Charger, Vintage and touring divisions on the card.
events.notes: Spectator pricing and times for this special were not posted (standard GA is $20).

events.title: 94.7 QDR 165 — NASCAR Regional Night
events.description: Friday-night NASCAR regional race night at the quarter-mile Wake County Speedway with Mini Stock, Late Model, Bombers/Any Car, Legends, Bandoleros, Champ Kart and Beginner divisions.

source.name: Wake County Speedway (official schedule via MyRacePass)

events.notes: Start time and ticket prices are not published online — check the track's Facebook page.

events.title: Red Clay Hill 165 — NASCAR Regional Night
events.description: Friday-night NASCAR regional race night at Wake County Speedway with Charger, Bombers/Any Car, Legends, Bandoleros, Vintage Modifieds, Champ Kart and Beginner divisions.

source.name: Wake County Speedway (official schedule via MyRacePass)

events.notes: Start time and ticket prices are not published online.

events.title: Wake County Speedway — Race Night
events.subtitle: Make-up date for the Aug 21 event
events.description: Make-up date for the postponed August 21 race night: Mini Stock, Late Model, Bombers/Any Car, Legends, Bandoleros and Beginner divisions.

source.name: Wake County Speedway (official schedule via MyRacePass)

events.title: Wake County Speedway — Race Night
events.subtitle: Make-up date for the Aug 28 event · season finale
events.description: Make-up date for the postponed August 28 race night — Mini Stock, Late Model, Bombers/Any Car, Legends and Bandoleros — and the last 2026 date currently posted.

source.name: Wake County Speedway (official schedule via MyRacePass)

events.title: Road to the Classic — Night 1
events.description: Saturday race night at the 4/10-mile Southern National Motorsports Park with Chargers, Legends, Bandoleros, Any Cars, SNMP Vintage and Allison Legacy divisions; an INEX oval national qualifier.
events.notes: Times and prices not posted.

events.title: Road to the Classic — Night 2 · Spooktacular
events.description: Halloween-night race with Late Model Stock Cars, Chargers, Any Cars, SNMP Vintage and ECFH divisions.
events.notes: Times and prices not posted.

events.title: North-South Shootout
events.description: Annual modified showdown with Tour-Type Modifieds, 602 Modifieds, Chargers, Legends and Any Cars. Practice day Friday, November 6.
events.notes: Times and prices not posted.

events.title: Thanksgiving Classic
events.subtitle: 26th annual · three days of Late Model Stock racing
events.description: Southern National's signature Thanksgiving-weekend Late Model Stock Car event, now in its 26th year, drawing top short-track drivers from across the Southeast.
events.notes: Daily times, divisions and ticket prices not posted yet.

events.title: NHRA Nationals at The Rock
events.description: NHRA Mission Foods Drag Racing Series national event returning professional drag racing to Rockingham Dragway — Top Fuel, Funny Car, Pro Stock, Pro Stock Motorcycle, Pro Mod and sportsman classes.
events.notes: Tickets via nhra.evenue.net; daily run schedule not yet posted. Map pin is approximate.

events.title: Ecosave 200
events.subtitle: NASCAR Craftsman Truck Series
events.description: Friday Truck Series race opening Charlotte Motor Speedway's fall NASCAR weekend, which returns to the 1.5-mile oval in 2026.
events.notes: Start time and ticket prices not shown on the speedway page.

events.title: Blue Cross NC 300
events.subtitle: NASCAR O'Reilly Auto Parts Series
events.description: Saturday O'Reilly Auto Parts Series race during Charlotte Motor Speedway's October NASCAR playoff weekend on the 1.5-mile oval.
events.notes: Start time and ticket prices not shown on the speedway page.

events.title: Bank of America 400
events.subtitle: NASCAR Cup Series playoffs · back on the oval
events.description: NASCAR Cup Series playoff race, run on the 1.5-mile oval in the fall for the first time since 2017 after eight years on the ROVAL. Race-day bundles include pre-race track access and a concert.
events.notes: Green flag 3:00 PM per the speedway; end time is an estimate.

events.title: Racing America at VIR
events.subtitle: Vintage & historic racing · formerly SVRA SpeedTour / Gold Cup
events.description: Four-day vintage and historic racing weekend on VIR's 3.27-mile road course, presented by Racing America and billed as a celebration of the track's history.
events.notes: Spectator ticket prices not shown.

events.title: Veterans Race of Remembrance
events.subtitle: Operation Motorsport 8-hour endurance weekend
events.description: Operation Motorsport's endurance racing weekend honoring military veterans, held over Veterans Day weekend at VIR in an expanded eight-hour format.

events.title: Charity Laps for Victory Junction
events.subtitle: Drive your own car on the full course
events.description: Fundraiser day where you pay $25 to drive your own car on VIR's 3.27-mile Full Course for a 15–20 minute touring session, benefiting Victory Junction.
events.notes: Session times not posted.

events.title: THSCC RallyCross — Points Events #8 & #9
events.description: Two-day Tarheel Sports Car Club rallycross weekend (timed runs on dirt and grass) at Jasper's Farm near Yanceyville. Entries via MotorsportReg; spectators welcome at the club's discretion.
events.notes: Street address, run times and entry fees not posted. Map pin is the town of Yanceyville, not the farm.

events.title: THSCC Autocross — Events #7 & #8
events.subtitle: Beast of the East weekend
events.venue: NCCAR — North Carolina Center for Automotive Research
events.description: Two-day Tarheel Sports Car Club autocross weekend at the NCCAR test facility, run as points events #7 and #8 and part of the Beast of the East series. Entries via MotorsportReg.
events.notes: Run times and entry fees not posted.

events.title: THSCC Autocross — Events #9 & #10
events.subtitle: Season finale
events.venue: NCCAR — North Carolina Center for Automotive Research
events.description: Season-closing two-day Tarheel Sports Car Club autocross weekend at NCCAR, run as points events #9 and #10. Entries via MotorsportReg.
events.notes: Run times and entry fees not posted.

events.title: Charlotte Auto Show
events.subtitle: 33rd annual · new-car brands, EVs and custom builds
events.description: Indoor auto show with dozens of gas, hybrid and electric brands plus custom builds and performance displays. Thu–Fri noon–9 PM, Sat 10 AM–9 PM, Sun 10 AM–6 PM, with a preview night Wednesday, November 18, 6:30–9 PM.
events.notes: Ticket prices not shown on the show's dates page.

events.title: Sean's Shack Cruise-In
events.subtitle: Monthly 3rd-Sunday cruise-in · weather permitting
events.description: Monthly third-Sunday cruise-in in the Sean's Shack parking lot on E. Millbrook Road with classic cars, burgers and shakes. Runs 1–5 pm, weather permitting; no burnouts.
events.notes: Listed as a monthly third-Sunday cruise-in; only Sep 20 is explicitly dated, and it runs weather permitting. No burnouts.

events.title: Cars & Coffee Greensboro
events.subtitle: 4th Saturday, March–October · General Greene Chapter AACA
events.venue: UNCG parking lot at W. Gate City Blvd & Chapman St (diagonally across from the Coliseum)
events.address: 1720 W Gate City Blvd, Greensboro, NC 27403
events.description: Free monthly gathering run by the General Greene Chapter of the AACA in the UNCG lot across from the Greensboro Coliseum; gates open 7:30 am, cars 8–10 am, lot cleared by 10:30 am.
events.notes: Fourth Saturday, March through October. Gates open 7:30 AM and the lot is cleared by 10:30 AM; schedule changes are posted on the group's Facebook page.

events.title: 3rd Annual Sandhills Bracket Championship
events.subtitle: Labor Day weekend bracket racing at The Rock
events.description: Three-day (Sat–Mon) bracket-racing championship on Rockingham Dragway's 2026 schedule.
events.notes: Three-day bracket-racing weekend (Sat–Mon). Times and admission are not posted on the track's schedule page; Friday Sep 4 is a test-and-tune day.

events.title: Super Chevy Show
events.subtitle: Chevrolet weekend at The Rock
events.description: Chevrolet-themed event listed for Saturday, Sept. 19 on Rockingham Dragway's 2026 schedule; program details are not on the schedule page.
events.notes: Only the name and date are on the track's schedule page; check the track for the program and admission.

events.title: 35th Annual Jim McClure All-Harley World Finals
events.subtitle: Top Fuel Harleys + full AMRA championship lineup
events.description: Top Fuel Harleys and the full American Motorcycle Racing Association championship lineup return to The Rock for what the track bills as the world's biggest Harley drag-racing event of the year.
events.notes: Thursday–Sunday passes are sold, so expect Thursday activity too. Gate times are not posted.

events.title: NHRA Lucas Oil Double Divisional
events.subtitle: NHRA Lucas Oil Drag Racing Series divisional weekend
events.description: Four-day (Thu–Sun) NHRA Lucas Oil Drag Racing Series event billed as a 'Double Divisional' on Rockingham Dragway's 2026 schedule.
events.notes: Four-day NHRA divisional (Thu–Sun). Times and admission are not posted on the schedule page.

events.title: MOPARS at The ROCK – Fall
events.subtitle: Same weekend as the Modern Street HEMI Shootout (Nov 14–15)
events.description: Mopar-themed event on Rockingham Dragway's 2026 schedule, paired with the Modern Street HEMI Shootout (hemirace.com) running Nov 14–15.
events.notes: Runs alongside the Modern Street HEMI Shootout (Nov 14–15). Times and admission are not posted; Friday Nov 13 is a test-and-tune day.

events.title: Import Mania
events.subtitle: Import-themed event at The Rock
events.description: Import-themed event listed for Sunday, Nov. 22 on Rockingham Dragway's 2026 schedule; no details link is provided on the schedule page.
events.notes: Only the name and date are on the track's schedule page; format, time and admission are unconfirmed.

events.title: THSCC RallyCross Wilson Points Event #10
events.subtitle: Tarheel Sports Car Club RallyCross
events.description: Tarheel Sports Car Club RallyCross points event at the Wilson County Fairgrounds; driver registration open on thscc.com.
events.notes: Participant event — drivers register through THSCC; ask the club about spectating. Map pin is the town of Wilson, not the fairgrounds.

events.title: THSCC HPDE/Track Day at NCCAR
events.subtitle: High-performance driving event · NCCAR road course
events.venue: NCCAR (North Carolina Center for Automotive Research)
events.description: Two-day Tarheel Sports Car Club high-performance driving event / track day on the NCCAR road course in Garysburg; registration open on thscc.com.
events.notes: Participant event with registration through THSCC; cost, daily schedule and spectator access are not posted.

events.title: THSCC RallyCross Wilson Points Events #11 & #12
events.subtitle: Tarheel Sports Car Club RallyCross · season-closing double
events.description: Two-day Tarheel Sports Car Club RallyCross points weekend (events #11 and #12) at the Wilson County Fairgrounds; driver registration open on thscc.com.
events.notes: Season-closing double points weekend; participant event with registration through THSCC. Map pin is the town of Wilson, not the fairgrounds.

events.title: 2026 TA Warp
events.subtitle: NCR SCCA Time Attack / track weekend at NCCAR
events.venue: NCCAR (North Carolina Center for Automotive Research)
events.description: North Carolina Region SCCA Time Attack event at the NCCAR road course; registration via MotorsportReg (msreg.com/26TAWarp).
events.notes: Time-attack weekend with registration through MotorsportReg (msreg.com/26TAWarp); times, cost and spectator access are not posted.

events.title: Charlotte AutoFair
events.subtitle: Spring show at Charlotte Motor Speedway · club displays, vendors, flea market
events.description: Three-day spring AutoFair that turns Charlotte Motor Speedway into a large automotive showcase with car-club displays, specialty vehicles, vendor displays and a flea market.
events.notes: Dates confirmed on the speedway's event page; daily hours and ticket prices had not been posted when checked.

events.title: Cars & Coffee Holly Springs
events.subtitle: 2nd Saturday mornings at Grand Hill Place
events.address: 324 Grand Hill Pl, Holly Springs, NC 27540
events.description: Community cars-and-coffee meet at the Grand Hill Place shopping center in Holly Springs, 9–11 am; next listed date is Saturday, Sept. 12, 2026.
events.notes: Second-Saturday pattern inferred from the 2026 dates listed; the organizer posts updates on Facebook (Cars and Coffee HS). Cost not listed.

events.title: Carbs & Carburetors
events.subtitle: Coffee, donuts and collector cars at Leland Little
events.description: Informal Saturday-morning gathering hosted by Leland Little with coffee, donuts and collector cars; attendees can browse or bring their own car to display.
events.notes: Hosted by Leland Little; an RSVP on Eventbrite is requested but not required.

events.title: "Pop The Frunk" Official EV Car Meet
events.subtitle: Electric-vehicle meet · 21+
events.description: EV-only car meet at Lynnwood Grill & Brewing Company in northwest Raleigh, billed as 'the Ultimate EV Car Meet for the coolest electric rides'; free parking, 21+.
events.notes: Date and noon start from Eventbrite's Raleigh listing; end time and ticket price were not shown. 21 and over.

events.title: 2nd Annual Classic Car Show
events.subtitle: E.E. Miller Recreation Center, Fayetteville
events.description: Community classic car show with food trucks, games, music and family activities at the E.E. Miller Recreation Center.
events.notes: Admission and registration cost are not listed on the Eventbrite page.

events.title: NASCAR Weekly Series Championship Night
events.subtitle: South Boston Speedway · Late Model Stock Cars, Limited Sportsman, Pure Stocks, Hornets
events.address: 1188 James D. Hagood Hwy, South Boston, VA 24592
events.admission: Advance $12 / gate $15; suites $40; seniors 65+, military & students $12 at gate; kids 12 & under free
events.description: Championship night for South Boston Speedway's four NASCAR Weekly Series divisions (Late Model Stock Cars, Limited Sportsman, Pure Stocks, Hornets); green flag 7 pm.
events.notes: Time shown is the 7 PM green flag; gates open earlier. About an hour north of the Triangle.

events.title: zMAX CARS Tour Championship
events.subtitle: CARS Late Model Stock Car Tour & CARS Pro Late Model Tour season finale
events.address: 1188 James D. Hagood Hwy, South Boston, VA 24592
events.admission: Advance $25 / gate $30; suites $50; seniors 65+, military, healthcare workers & students $25 at gate; kids 12 & under free
events.description: Season-ending zMAX CARS Tour championship event featuring the CARS Late Model Stock Car Tour and CARS Pro Late Model Tour; green flag 7 pm.
events.notes: Time shown is the 7 PM green flag; gates open earlier. Last 2026 event on the track's calendar.

events.title: Ace Speedway Race Night
events.subtitle: Asphalt Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks, Small Block Modifieds
events.description: Friday-night short-track racing at Ace Speedway in Altamahaw with Asphalt Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks and Small Block Modifieds, per the track's 2026 MyRacePass schedule.
events.notes: Start time and ticket prices are not posted on the MyRacePass schedule; the track's own website was offline when checked.

events.title: LMS Twins
events.subtitle: Late Models, Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks, Small Block Modifieds
events.description: 'LMS Twins' Friday-night event at Ace Speedway (Late Model Stock twin features, per the name) with Late Models, Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks and Small Block Modifieds, per the track's 2026 MyRacePass schedule.
events.notes: Start time and ticket prices are not posted on the MyRacePass schedule; the track's own website was offline when checked.

events.title: Ace Speedway Race Night
events.subtitle: Late Models, Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks, Small Block Modifieds
events.description: Friday-night short-track racing at Ace Speedway with Late Models, Limited Late Models, Mini Stocks and Small Block Modifieds; the last 2026 date shown on the track's MyRacePass schedule.
events.notes: Start time and ticket prices are not posted on the MyRacePass schedule; the track's own website was offline when checked.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Fayetteville
events.subtitle: 2nd Saturday, year-round · Millstone Towne Centre
events.description: Monthly all-makes meet (classics, modern, muscle, import, exotic, off-road) on the second Saturday of every month, year-round, 9 am–noon at Millstone Towne Centre.

source.name: Cars and Coffee Fayetteville, NC (organizer site)

events.notes: The organizer states the second-Saturday rule but does not list dates; updates are posted on the group's Facebook page. Cost not stated.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Fuquay-Varina (Cars in the Quay)
events.subtitle: 3rd Saturday at Aviator Brewing
events.description: Monthly all-makes gathering at Aviator Brewing in Fuquay-Varina with a themed display-parking section each month (Sep 19, 2026: BMW; Oct 17: Mercedes and Audi; Nov 21: Corvettes; Dec 19: holiday selection). Contact carsinthequay@gmail.com to apply for themed display parking.
events.notes: Every third Saturday, 8–11 AM. Each month a marque gets the display section (Sep: BMW; Oct: Mercedes and Audi; Nov: Corvettes; Dec: holiday selection). Email carsinthequay@gmail.com for display parking.

events.title: Sandhills Motoring Club Cars & Coffee
events.subtitle: First Sunday in the Village of Pinehurst
events.venue: The Roast Office, Village of Pinehurst
events.description: Public monthly gathering of the Sandhills Motoring Club in the Village of Pinehurst; all makes and models welcome, with parking in front of The Roast Office and in designated village lots.
events.notes: First Sunday, 9–11 AM, in the Village of Pinehurst; parking in front of The Roast Office and the village lots. About an hour from the Triangle.

events.title: Cars & Coffee Roxboro
events.subtitle: Second Saturday, April through December
events.description: Community Cars & Coffee held the second Saturday of the month from April through December on Durham Road in Roxboro.
events.notes: Second Saturday, 8:30–11 AM, April through December; remaining 2026 dates are Sep 12, Oct 10, Nov 14 and Dec 12.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Pittsboro
events.description: Second-Saturday morning meet in downtown Pittsboro, held year-round, weather permitting.
events.notes: Second Saturday, 8–11 AM, year-round and weather permitting. Updates are posted on the Cars and Coffee Pittsboro Facebook page.

events.title: 2nd Saturday Car & Bike Meet & Greet
events.subtitle: Hosted by HHE at Smokey's, Burlington
events.description: Monthly car and motorcycle meet-and-greet hosted by HHE in a dedicated side lot at Smokey's in Burlington, with a food truck on site; no cover charge.
events.notes: Runs from noon into the evening in the side lot at Smokey's, weather permitting; food truck on site.

events.title: Cars and Coffee Garner
events.subtitle: 3rd Sunday at Full Bloom Coffee Roasters · classics, hot rods and show cars
events.description: Relaxed third-Sunday meet in the Full Bloom Coffee Roasters lot in downtown Garner, aimed at pre-1980s classics, hot rods, rat rods and show cars. Shine only; check for rain cancellations.
events.notes: Listings disagree on the hours (8:30–10:30 AM or 9 AM–1 PM); the organizer posts updates on Instagram @carsandcoffeegarner. Shine only.

events.title: Goldsboro Gears N Grinds
events.subtitle: 3rd Saturday at GBW The Filling Station
events.description: Cars-and-coffee style morning gathering for car enthusiasts in downtown Goldsboro on the third Saturday of each month.
events.notes: Third Saturday, 8–10 AM, in downtown Goldsboro. About an hour from the Triangle.

events.title: Downtown Elon Cars and Coffee
events.subtitle: 2nd Saturday, April through October
events.description: Monthly cars and coffee hosted by Downtown Elon and The Oak House coffee shop on the second Saturday of each month, April through October; open to owners and observers alike.
events.notes: Second Saturday, 8–10 AM, April through October, hosted by Downtown Elon and The Oak House.

events.title: Wake Forest Cars & Coffee
events.subtitle: 4th Saturday at Gateway Commons
events.address: 950 Gateway Commons Cir, Wake Forest, NC 27587
events.description: Volunteer-run fourth-Saturday meet in the Gateway Commons shopping-center lot off Hwy 98 East in Wake Forest; everything from old-school to exotic cars and motorcycles, with food, restrooms and coffee on site.
events.notes: Fourth Saturday, 8–11 AM, in the Gateway Commons lot off Hwy 98 East; times can change, so check before going. Don't park in front of Lowes Foods past the cones.

events.title: Wake Forest Sunday Cars and Coffee
events.subtitle: Informal weekly gathering on South White Street
events.address: 156 S White St, Wake Forest, NC 27587
events.description: Informal Sunday-morning gathering along South White Street near East Jones Street in downtown Wake Forest; bring your own beverage or grab one at Wake Forest Coffee Company.
events.notes: Informal weekly gathering along South White Street near East Jones Street; bring a coffee or grab one at Wake Forest Coffee Company.

events.title: Cruise Nights at The Burger Boy
events.subtitle: 3rd Saturday evenings, April through November
events.description: Monthly Saturday-evening cruise-in hosted by the Burger Boy Restaurant in Wilson, free for vehicles and spectators, with food available from the restaurant.
events.notes: Third Saturday evenings, 4–8 PM, April through November; free for cars and spectators, with food from the restaurant.

events.title: Four Oaks Chamber Car, Truck, and Motorcycle Show
events.subtitle: Acorn Festival weekend, downtown Four Oaks
events.address: 109 W South Railroad St, Four Oaks, NC 27524
events.description: Chamber of Commerce car, truck and motorcycle show in downtown Four Oaks featuring classic, custom and modern vehicles, held the same day as the Four Oaks Acorn Festival.
events.notes: Held during the Four Oaks Acorn Festival; spectator admission and registration were not listed.

events.title: Hog Day Classic Car Show
events.subtitle: Hillsborough Hog Day festival
events.description: Classic car show held as part of Hillsborough's annual Hog Day festival, alongside live music, a BBQ cook-off, crafts and a 5K.
events.notes: Part of Hillsborough's Hog Day festival (live music, BBQ cook-off, 5K). Confirm which day and hours the car show runs.

events.title: Triple Crown Charity Car Show
events.description: All-makes charity car show in Sanford with classic, custom and modern vehicles on display.
events.notes: All-makes charity show; admission and beneficiary were not listed.

events.title: Show, Shine, Shag & Dine Car Show
events.subtitle: Downtown Henderson / Kerr Lake
events.admission: Free for spectators; $25 car display entry
events.description: Annual antique, classic and nostalgia-drag car show for 1995-and-older vehicles with awards in 30 classes; a Friday-evening cruise-in at Kerr Lake precedes the Saturday main show. No rain date.
events.notes: For 1995-and-older vehicles, awards in 30 classes; a Friday-evening cruise-in at Kerr Lake precedes the Saturday show. No rain date.

events.title: Interstate 95 Meets — Every 1st Friday
events.subtitle: Car meet at Southern National Motorsports Park
events.description: Monthly first-Friday car meet at Southern National Motorsports Park with more than 100 awards, a 'legal mega pit', live music, vendors and special guests; a waiver is required to attend.
events.notes: First Friday of the month; the listing does not say which months it runs, so confirm before a winter visit. A waiver is required to attend.

events.title: Stray Cats 31st Annual Rod & Custom Charity Car Show
events.address: 149 E South Main St, Littleton, NC 27850
events.description: Annual charity rod-and-custom show on South Main Street in Littleton; organizers say more than 220 classic cars and trucks registered last year.
events.notes: Listings disagree on the hours (8 AM–3 PM or 6–10 PM), so confirm before going. Entry fee and admission not posted. About 90 miles from Morrisville.

events.title: THSCC Karting GP #8 | Summer Series #4 (Final)
events.subtitle: Tarheel Sports Car Club arrive-and-drive kart Grand Prix
